### Relative Values
Author: Stuart Briscoe (One Year Devotions for Men)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/relative-values-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-28.html
Passage: Numbers 20:18, 21
Points:
- Unresolved grievances among relatives can persist across generations and produce deep bitterness.
- Moses respectfully requested peaceful passage through Edom, promising not to damage or deplete any resources.
- Edom's harsh refusal and military threats exposed longstanding animosity dating back to Jacob and Esau.
- Israel chose a wearisome detour over needless conflict, recognizing that discretion was better than retaliation.
- Believers must actively work to diffuse estrangement rather than allowing family grudges to fester.
